info.title: Content
info.description:
The `content-v10.0` component type. Each component below is one addressable piece of content, and its operations are what you can do with it. Rendered against your own program domain.

**Preview for the ENG-30863 design review, not a merge candidate.** Generated from the component inventory; no component declares `operations[]` yet.
